scope: Fictional fixtures in isolated browser contexts; no real user records or credentials.

checks: Separate settings links reach bank/card connection, notifications, salary period and privacy
Budget period and expected payday remain independently editable and saved
Unavailable automatic linking gives an immediate usable manual account form without changing the user's budget period
The CSV shortcut adds the first card and resumes file selection, preview and an actual encrypted expense import
Repeated CSV import leaves duplicate rows unselected and cannot silently duplicate recorded spending
Reminder setup creates one generic daily calendar file during the submit gesture without financial data
Privacy actions open the correct settings sheets and closing removes the panel URL
Separated settings, account editor and CSV importer fit 375/390px in both light and dark modes
OAuth parameters are removed before unlock and a first connection failure is visible without losing existing records
Independent payday 25 and period day 31 preserved; expected pay is not recorded income
Calendar mode hides irrelevant empty day without blocking save or losing stored day
One tap prepares generic daily .ics, saves the chosen time, and shows import-required wording
Denied notification permission leaves all persisted reminder settings unchanged
Privacy lock/backup links open the correct sheet; close removes query and Back returns to Privacy

checks.name: Runtime source excludes plaintext browser storage, console output and client secrets
Moneytree API restricts token destination and disables browser response caching
Service Worker caches static app/OCR assets only; receipt image saving is explicit and OCR remains local
Atomic legacy migration decrypts every seeded financial record and draft unchanged
Native IndexedDB inspection: every non-metadata store is encrypted; every persisted index is blinded
Fresh IVs, locked-tab rejection, key disposal and wrong-passphrase preservation
Schema 1 compatibility, schema 2 round trip and encrypted export; provider credentials excluded
Injected migration failure leaves all legacy records intact and the vault disabled
Mock/manual and unconfigured Moneytree adapters perform zero network requests or credential writes

privacy.scope: Runtime source review and disposable fake IndexedDB with fictional fixtures; not a penetration test or device-storage recovery guarantee.
